**A curated reference database of viral marker-gene sequences for *Nucleocytoviricota* within *Bamfordvirae***

VirMarkDB provides taxon-aware HMM profiles and curated protein/nucleotide sequences for eight conserved marker genes, built from ICTV-derived taxonomy.

[Explore the database](database.qmd){.btn-action} [See the workflow](workflow.qmd){.btn-action} [Download](releases.qmd){.btn-action}

:::
